body:
> * I think this behavior should also apply when running the main scene if its root node is a Node3D. Otherwise, the behavior you get between running the main scene and the current scene differs, which can be unexpected when you're currently editing the main scene.

Done. There was a lot of discussion in https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/5800 between whether it should be for the main scene or using the current/specific scene options. I've enabled it for the main scene though now so we can play around with it and decide what's best. There is some weirdness now though where if you toggle the sun/environment previews on the scene you are viewing and run, it will use those overrides even if you don't have them disabled on the main scene.

> * The 3 warnings on startup take a lot of space in the editor **Debugger > Errors** panel:
> 
> ![image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/180032/416319955-45ad3055-d290-452f-981b-da20835985ed.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJnaXRodWIuY29tIiwiYXVkIjoicmF3LmdpdGh1YnVzZXJjb250ZW50LmNvbSIsImtleSI6ImtleTUiLCJleHAiOjE3NDA0NTI5NTYsIm5iZiI6MTc0MDQ1MjY1NiwicGF0aCI6Ii8xODAwMzIvNDE2MzE5OTU1LTQ1YWQzMDU1LWQyOTAtNDUyZi05ODFiLWRhMjA4MzU5ODVlZC5wbmc_.wJ6oNDkRo-lFR42R-6m71Mf1SLGWEK-QtRev8yiXnNU)
> 
> To resolve this, we should consolidate them into a single warning message that lists the nodes that were added:
> 

Done.

> 
> * The setting name is pretty long (I believe it's the longest setting name we have right now). I suggest shortening it to **Add Preview Nodes When Running Scene**. This also makes the setting name agnostic between 2D and 3D, in case we decide to add a preview node system to 2D in the future.

Done. (could be awarded for longest setting name ;))

> * There's a visible gray screen flash when the missing nodes are being added (watch the video at 0.5× speed). This does not occur if the nodes were added to the scene before running it. Is there a way we could avoid it, e.g. by disabling the render loop until all preview nodes have been added?

Looking into this, although not really sure where we could do this at. It seems like the debugger stuff I am using comes after, so not sure how I'd delay rendering til all the nodes were added.

A bit of the code is still messy, but just leaving it now to test stuff. I'll clean it up depending on where this heads.

Thanks for the testing as well!
